facts.fact: Around 25 million Nigerians whose names are on the national social register received federal cash payments, per the report; the minister said the government will continue to establish a reliable social register.
Beneficiaries on the national social register are verified biometrically using their NIN and BVN, per the report.
People on the national social register received cash payments, with benefits paid through bank accounts or digital money wallets, per the finance minister.
